snippet.title: Deathmaze 5000 - Med Systems Software, 1980 - TRS-80 (4K)
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Frank Corr's second game, Deathmaze 5000, published by Med Systems Software for the TRS-80 in 1980.

Get a bit of the story here:
Q-Bits From my Personal Collection – Deathmaze 5000, a 1980 first-person 3D survival adventure
